title: When the Promise Turns
author: X. M. Voss
blurb: Isandro Vasquez, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
